in_sanskrit.name: ईयप्प
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Name of the son of Shiva, also known as Ayyappa, who is considered the lord of the hunt and protector of the forests and wildlife.

in_marathi.name: Iyappa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iyappa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Iyappa is the son of Lord Shiva and goddess Parvathi. He is considered the god of war, strength and courage.

in_bengali.name: Iyappa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of War
in_bengali.long_meaning: Iyappa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Iyappa is the son of Lord Shiva and goddess Parvathi. He is considered the god of war, strength and courage.
